    # Look for recently created .nid files (Nanosurf Image Data format)
    found_files = []
    for base_path in common_paths:
        if os.path.exists(base_path):
            # Search for .nid files

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² with 128x128 points
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Print current parameters
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved image path
# The AFM software automatically saves images to its configured directory
# We need to get the most recent file from the gallery
try:
    # Get the gallery path from the application
    gallery_path = application.GalleryPath
    print(f"Gallery path: {gallery_path}")
    
    # List all files in the gallery directory
    if os.path.exists(gallery_path):
        files = [os.path.join(gallery_path, f) for f in os.listdir(gallery_path) if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(gallery_path, f))]
        if files:
            # Get the most recent file
            latest_file = max(files, key=os.path.getctime)
            print(f"Latest image file: {latest_file}")
            image_path = os.path.abspath(latest_file)
        else:
            image_path = "No files found in gallery"
    else:
        image_path = f"Gallery path does not exist: {gallery_path}"
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting image path: {e}")
    image_path = "Error retrieving image path"

del spm

print(f"Final image path: {image_path}")

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² with 128x128 points
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set file name prefix
file_name = "afm_scan_10x10um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm², {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} points")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")

# Get the last saved file path
# The image is automatically saved by the AFM software
# We need to get the file path from the application
try:
    # Get the current working directory where images are saved
    last_file = application.GetLastSavedFileName()
    print(f"Image saved at: {last_file}")
except:
    print("Could not retrieve file path directly, checking default location...")
    # If direct method doesn't work, construct the path
    last_file = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), file_name + "001.nid")
    print(f"Expected path: {last_file}")

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
print("Initializing AFM...")
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 20x20 µm² image with 128x128 resolution
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Get current parameters to verify
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan (bottom to top)
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved image path
# The AFM software automatically saves images to a default directory
# We need to retrieve the path of the last saved image
last_image_path = scan.LastImagePath if hasattr(scan, 'LastImagePath') else None

if last_image_path:
    print(f"Image saved at: {last_image_path}")
else:
    print("Image path not directly available from API")

# Clean up
del spm
print("AFM session closed")

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
print("Initializing AFM...")
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 20x20 µm² with 128x128 resolution
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set file name prefix
file_name = "afm_scan_20x20um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

# Print current parameters
print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm")
print(f"  Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm")
print(f"  Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"  Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"  Operating Mode: Contact (LateralForce)")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
try:
    last_file = application.GetLastSavedFile()
    print(f"Image saved at: {last_file}")
except:
    print("Could not retrieve last saved file path directly")
    last_file = None

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce)...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 20x20 µm² with 128x128 resolution
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Print current parameters
print(f"Scan size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines}")
print(f"Operating mode: Contact (LateralForce)")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
try:
    last_file = application.LastSavedFile
    print(f"Image saved at: {last_file}")
except:
    print("Could not retrieve LastSavedFile property")
    last_file = None

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
print("Initializing AFM...")
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Dynamic/Tapping mode (minimizes tip damage)
print("Setting operating mode to Dynamic AFM (tapping mode)...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.DynamicAFM

# Set scan parameters
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm², {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} pixels")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
try:
    last_file = application.GetLastSavedFile()
    print(f"Image saved at: {last_file}")
    image_path = last_file
except:
    print("Could not retrieve last saved file path directly")
    image_path = None

del spm

# Print final result
if image_path:
    print(f"Final image path: {image_path}")

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 20x20 µm² with 128x128 resolution
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Print current parameters to verify
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan (bottom to top)
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {scan.Lines - scan.Currentline}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")

# Get the saved image path
# The image is typically saved in the default directory
# We need to get the last saved file path
try:
    # Try to get the file path from scan object
    if hasattr(scan, 'FileName'):
        image_path = scan.FileName
        print(f"Image saved at: {image_path}")
    else:
        print("FileName attribute not available")
        image_path = None
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting file path: {e}")
    image_path = None

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact Mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact Mode (LateralForce)...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 30x30 µm² with 128x128 resolution
print("Setting scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set reasonable Z controller parameters for contact mode
print("Setting PID gains for contact mode...")
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

# Get current parameters to verify
print(f"Scan configured:")
print(f"  Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6:.1f} µm")
print(f"  Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight*1e6:.1f} µm")
print(f"  Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"  Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"  Operating Mode: Contact Mode (LateralForce)")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
# The AFM software automatically saves images to a default directory
# We need to get the file path from the application
try:
    # Try to get the last saved file information
    last_file = application.GetLastSavedFileName()
    print(f"Image saved to: {last_file}")
except:
    print("Could not retrieve automatic file path")
    last_file = None

del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 30x30 µm² with 128x128 resolution
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set file name prefix
file_name = "afm_scan_30um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm², {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} pixels")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
# The file is automatically saved by the AFM software
# We need to get the gallery path and construct the full path
try:
    # Try to get the last saved file information
    gallery_path = application.GalleryPath
    print(f"Gallery path: {gallery_path}")
    
    # List files in the gallery directory to find the most recent one
    if os.path.exists(gallery_path):
        files = [os.path.join(gallery_path, f) for f in os.listdir(gallery_path) if f.startswith(file_name)]
        if files:
            # Get the most recent file
            latest_file = max(files, key=os.path.getctime)
            print(f"Latest saved file: {latest_file}")
        else:
            print("No files found with the specified prefix")
            latest_file = None
    else:
        print(f"Gallery path does not exist: {gallery_path}")
        latest_file = None
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting file path: {e}")
    latest_file = None

del spm

import time
import os

# Initialize AFM
print("Initializing AFM...")
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact Mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact Mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 30x30 µm² with 128x128 resolution
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set reasonable PID gains for contact mode
print("Setting Z controller parameters...")
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

# Get current parameters for verification
print(f"Scan configured:")
print(f"  Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6:.1f} µm")
print(f"  Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight*1e6:.1f} µm")
print(f"  Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"  Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"  Operating Mode: Contact Mode (LateralForce)")

# Start the scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# The image should be automatically saved by the AFM software
# Try to get the last saved file path
print("\nImage captured successfully!")

# Clean up
del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Contact mode (LateralForce) to minimize tip damage
print("Setting operating mode to Contact mode...")
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.LateralForce

# Set scan parameters for 30x30 µm² with 128x128 resolution
print("Configuring scan parameters...")
scan.ImageWidth = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Set file name prefix
file_name = "afm_scan_30um_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

print(f"Scan configured: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6}x{scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm², {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines} pixels")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the last saved file path
# The file is automatically saved by the system
# We need to get the gallery history path
try:
    # Get the current working directory where files are saved
    gallery_path = application.GalleryHistoryPath
    print(f"Gallery path: {gallery_path}")
    
    # List files in the gallery directory to find the most recent one
    if os.path.exists(gallery_path):
        files = [os.path.join(gallery_path, f) for f in os.listdir(gallery_path) if f.startswith(file_name)]
        if files:
            # Get the most recent file
            latest_file = max(files, key=os.path.getctime)
            print(f"Latest saved file: {latest_file}")
        else:
            print("No files found with the specified prefix")
    else:
        print(f"Gallery path does not exist: {gallery_path}")
except Exception as e:
